paite: Huan Israel suante omkhawm Sin gamdai a pan azin ua, TOUPA thupiak bang a azin nung un Rephidim ah apuanin uh akai uhi. Huai ah mite dawn ding tui a-om kei hi.
heading: Suangpi A Pan Tui / (Nam 20.1-13)
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to Yahweh’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.

paite: Huaiziak in mite'n Mosi akinakpih ua, "Ka dawn ding uh tui hon pia in," achi uhi. Mosi in akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon kinakpih na hi ua? Bangziak a TOUPA ze-et na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test Yahweh?”

paite: Mite lah tui duh in huai ah adang uh atak a; Mosi tung ah mite aphun ua, "Dangtakna a kou leh ka tate uh leh ka gante uh hon that dia, bangziak a Aigupta gam a pan hon lakhia na hia?" achi uhi.
english: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”

paite: TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akap a, "Hiai mite bang ka loh dia? Suang a hon denglum ding in mansa in a-om uhi," achi hi.
english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mite ma ah pai inla, Israel upate tonpih inla; lui na satna chiang na khut in tawi inla, pai in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.

paite: Ngai in, Horeb ah suangpi tung ah na ma ah ka dingh ding a, suangpi na sat dia, huai a pan tui ahong pawtkhe ding, mite'n adawntheihna ding un," achi hi. Israel upate muh in Mosi in huchibang in ahihta hi.
english: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

paite: Huai mun min Massah leh Meribah asa hi, Israel suante'n TOUPA tawng a, amah chian in, "I lak uah TOUPA a-om hia, om lou," achih ziak un.
english: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested Yahweh, saying, “Is Yahweh among us, or not?”

paite: Huai khit in Amalek ahong kuan a, Rephidim ah Israelte ahong dou hi.
heading: Amalek Toh Kidouna
english: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

paite: Mosi in Joshua kiang ah, “Mi hon telkhia inla, pawtkhe ni in, Amalek i dou ding. Zingchiang in ka khut a Pathian' chiangkhun tawi in mualvum ah ka kuan ding," achi hi.
english: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in akiang a, agen bang in Joshua in ahih a, Amalek adou uhi. Mosi leh Aaron leh Hur mualvum ah ahohtouta uhi.
english: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in akhut aliktouh chiang in, Israelte ahat ua; akhut akhiaksuk chiang in, Amalek ahat hi.
english: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

paite: Himahleh Mosi khut agik a; huchi in suang ala ua, anuai ah akoih uhi. Huai tung ah amah atu a, Aaron leh Hur in akhut adoptouhsak uhi; khat in akhat lam pang, leh adang pen in akhat lam pang ah. Huchi in nitum matan akhutte apangzou hi.
english: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.

paite: Huchi in Joshua in Amalek leh amite anamsau in azouta hi.
english: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Theihgige ding in hiai laibu ah gelh inla, Joshua bil ah gen nawn in. Van nuai a pan Amalek theihgigena ka koihmang sipsip ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”

paite: Mosi in huai ah maitam adoh a, amin Jehovah-nissi asa hi.
english: Moses built an altar, and called its name “Yahweh our Banner”.

paite: "Akhang akhang a TOUPA'N Amalek dou gige ding chi a akichiam ziak in,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Yah has sworn: ‘Yahweh will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”
